name: strj
description: 2026 Q3 季度考智能备考与高思奥数刷题系统
author: 卓越教育

scripts.build:public: node scripts/validate-public-assets.mjs && tsc -b && vite build --mode public && node scripts/prune-mobile-dist.mjs && node scripts/verify-public-build.mjs
scripts.build:desktop:web: tsc -b && vite build --mode desktop && node scripts/prune-mobile-dist.mjs
scripts.build:desktop:internal: node scripts/validate-public-assets.mjs && tsc -b && vite build --mode desktop && node scripts/prune-mobile-dist.mjs && node scripts/verify-internal-build.mjs
scripts.build:desktop:public: node scripts/validate-public-assets.mjs && tsc -b && vite build --mode desktop-public && node scripts/prune-mobile-dist.mjs && node scripts/verify-public-build.mjs
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build:desktop:web && electron-builder --win nsis portable --config.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.desktop:dist:public: npm run build:desktop:public && electron-builder --win nsis portable --config.directories.output=release-public-desktop --config.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.desktop:dist:internal: npm run build:desktop:internal && electron-builder --win nsis portable --config.directories.output=release-internal-desktop --config.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.release:internal: npm run desktop:dist:internal && npm run desktop:dist:mac:internal && npm run cap:apk:internal && npm run build:desktop:internal && npm run release:assemble && npm run release:audit
scripts.cap:build: npm run build && node scripts/prune-mobile-dist.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:build:public: npm run build:public && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:build:internal: npm run build && node scripts/prune-mobile-dist.mjs && node scripts/verify-internal-build.mjs && npx cap sync android
scripts.release:verify: npm test && npm run lint && npm run build
